test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letter that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series. 

_ M _ _ G _ D _ _ M _ C G _ D C

options.text: G D C M C G D G
M D C M C G D M
G D C M C G D M
G D C D C G D M

solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given: _ M _ _ G _ D _ _ M _ C G _ D C

Let's check each option:

1) G D C M C G D G → __G__ M __D__ __C__ - G __M__ D __C__ - __G__ M __D__ C - G __G__ D C

2) M D C M C G D M → __M__ M __D__ __C__ - G __M__ D __C__ - __G__ M __D__ C - G __M__ D C​

3) **G D C M C G D M** → __G__ M __D__ __C__ - G __M__ D __C__ - __G__ M __D__ C - G __M__ D C

__
 
• Here, we can see a pattern.
 
 
• '**G M D C**' is repeating itself.
 
 

4) G D C D C G D M → G__ M __D__ __C__ - G __D__ D __C__ - __G__ M __D__ C - G __M__ D C

Hence, "**G D C M C G D M**" is the correct answer.
